reviews.title: Potaroma Cat Toys 3 pcs Squeak Mice.
reviews.body: These toys do not squeak. I purchased once and returned them because they didn't sqeak as stated in product description. I waited a while and ordered again when item was restocked. They still do not squeak. Maybe the seller should change product description. I will give 3 stars because my cat will play with it.
reviews.author: Elaine R

reviews.title: VERY NICE PRODUCT!
reviews.body: Just received these.  My cat already loves them!  They are a nice size..... Great for playing with your cat or the cat playing with them themselves.  They seem to be sturdy and well made and my cat took to them immediately.  She is actually talking to one right now! 😁😃🤗

reviews.title: They do not squeak
reviews.body: Cats enjoy them but they don’t squeak. There’s nothing inside them, on them, anywhere that squeaks. I tested all three and nada.They like the catnip part at least.  Not the full stimulation I was seeking for my cats though.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.title: Toy doesn’t have any sound. Disappointing!!!!
reviews.body: All three of the toys don’t make any sounds.  Disappointing cause that’s why I purchased it.  I want a refund
